entries.title: Version 1.0.680
entries.summary: CLI release 1.0.680 published. New files: `agents/base2/base2-free-mimo-pro.ts`, `agents/base2/base2-free-mimo.ts`, `agents/base2/base2-mimo.ts`, `agents/reviewer/code-reviewer-mimo-pro.ts` (+7 more). Removed: `.agents/claude-code-cli.ts`, `.agents/codebuff-local-cli.ts`, `.agents/codex-cli.ts`, `.agents/constants.ts` (+8 more). Renamed 1 file(s).

ai.title: Remove local agent framework from dot-agents directory
ai.summary: This sweep deletes the entire local `.agents/` directory tree, including the CLI agent factory (`createCliAgent`), its prompt/schema/type libraries, the shared `AgentDefinition` type, and all concrete local agent definitions. The surviving `agents/types/agent-definition.ts` is the public type for custom Codebuff agents, not the deleted local one. This is part of the 1.0.680 release-bump that concurrently deletes the larger `agents-graveyard/` tree and rewrites contribution docs.
ai.evidence: The commit deletes the entire `.agents/` directory (including `create-cli-agent.ts`, `cli-agent-prompts.ts`, `cli-agent-schemas.ts`, `cli-agent-types.ts`, and all concrete agent definitions like `claude-code-cli.ts`), which removes all imports of `AgentDefinition` from `.agents/types/agent-definition.ts` and the now-unused public type re-exported from `agents/types/agent-definition.ts`.
ai.unknowns: The deletion rationale (cleanup, migration target, or deprecation) is not shown in the diff notes.

changes.what: Deleted the entire `.agents/` directory, removing the `createCliAgent` factory, CLI agent prompt/schema/type libraries, base type definitions, session records, and all concrete local agent definitions.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: gravity-index
entries.summary: Shared/Core, Agent Runtime changes across 3 file(s) (+162/−83).

ai.title: Gravity Index schema refactor and attribution metadata
ai.summary: Gravity Index tool input schema refactored into discrete Zod objects (search, browse, get_service) with explicit runtime attribution fields. Agent runtime handler now injects session, repo, and step IDs into request metadata before API call. Tool description updated to prioritize credential_request.setup_url over generic conversion links. Scope limited to common/types and agent-runtime handlers.

eli5.text: When the assistant looks up a service for you to connect to (like a database or email provider), it now passes along your current session, the project repo, and the specific step you're on, so each lookup is tagged with where it came from. The service catalog information is also reorganized behind the scenes into clearer sections for searching, browsing, and getting setup details. If you use the assistant to integrate a service, you may notice the credential setup link it points you to is now the tracked signup URL, shown as a 'Get your {service name} API key' button when available. This is live today for anyone using the Gravity Index integration flow.

entries.title: Test coverage: freebuff-models
entries.summary: Tests only (`freebuff-models`, +50/−33): the suite moved, no shipped code edits.

ai.title: Remove MiMo Pro tagline test
ai.summary: Removed test asserting MiMo Pro tagline is 'Smartest multimodal' from freebuff-models.test.ts. Suite-only change; no shipped code edits. Covers common/src/__tests__/freebuff-models.test.ts.

eli5.text: The team stopped running a small internal check that verified the description next to one premium-tier AI model still read a specific phrase; nothing you see in the app changes, and the model's description itself was already updated separately. If you opened the project's test files, you would no longer find that check listed among the things they run. This is behind-the-scenes cleanup only.

ai.title: MiMo 2.5 Pro tagline grammar fix
ai.summary: Tagline for MiMo 2.5 Pro corrected from 'Smartest & Slower' to 'Smartest & Slow' in common/src/constants/freebuff-models.ts. Fixes inconsistent comparative adjective usage in model metadata. Scope limited to shared core constants affecting CLI, Web, and Desktop pickers.

eli5.text: The tagline shown for MiMo 2.5 Pro has changed from 'Smartest & Slower' to 'Smartest & Slow'. This corrects a small grammar inconsistency and only affects the text displayed next to the model name in the model picker used across the assistant's apps. You would notice the updated wording if you opened the model selection menu; the change is live today.

ai.title: base2 agent drops isFast gate on suggestfollowups
ai.summary: suggest_followups tool and its prompt directive no longer gated on !isFast in agents/base2/base2.ts. Only !noAskUser controls availability. Fast-mode agents now receive followup suggestions. Skill-loading prompt line removed from buildImplementationStepPrompt.

eli5.text: When you use the assistant in its quick, streamlined mode, it can now follow up your task with suggested next steps. Previously, that mode turned follow-up suggestions off, so after a fast answer you'd just get the result and nothing else. The rule that blocked suggestions in fast mode is gone, so the same suggestions you see in normal mode now appear there too. If you ask something and get a quick reply, you may notice a short list of next things you could try appearing at the end.

facts: Use the shared Enter detector so the keypad Enter and the niche Linux terminals that send \n (linefeed) for Enter also commit; a raw name === 'return' check silently ignores those, which looks like a frozen menu (arrows move the highlight, Enter does nothing).
Recursively replace any lone (unpaired) UTF-16 surrogate with U+FFFD in every string reachable from `value`, mutating objects/arrays in place.

Sanitizing here, at the single chokepoint where all messages are converted to provider format, guarantees a single bad character can never poison the conversation regardless of which tool produced it. It is a no-op on already-valid strings, so valid emoji, base64, etc. are untouched.
Arrays and plain objects are both handled here: Object.keys enumerates array indices too, and indexing by string key mutates the element in place.

Neutralize any lone UTF-16 surrogates before the messages reach the provider. These are mutated in place; every aggregated message is a fresh clone (see convertToolMessage), so the caller's message history is unaffected.
entries.title: CLI update: freebuff-model-selector

ai.title: Fix CLI Enter key detection and sanitize message surrogates
ai.summary: CLI model selector and waiting room now use `isPlainEnterKey` to correctly handle keypad Enter and linefeed, fixing frozen menu behavior on niche Linux terminals. `common/src/util/messages.ts` adds `wellFormStringsInPlace` to recursively replace lone UTF-16 surrogates with U+FFFD before provider requests. This prevents strict server-side parsers (e.g., Rust serde_json) from rejecting entire request bodies due to corrupted history from unsafe truncation. Sanitization occurs at the message conversion chokepoint, mutating fresh clones to avoid affecting local history.

eli5.text: When you press Enter to pick a model or confirm something in the terminal app, it now works correctly even on some Linux setups and keyboards where Enter sends a slightly different signal, previously the menu could look stuck even though you hit the key. At the same time, the app now automatically cleans up stray broken characters (the kind left behind when text is accidentally chopped in half mid-emoji) inside your conversation before sending it to the AI, so a single corrupted character can no longer make the whole conversation fail on the AI provider's side. Both fixes are live today.
